title: Pineapples, migrants and the regions: the other side of Costa Rica
goal: Describe the work, the migration and the regional gaps in Costa Rica, choosing between the infinitive and que + subjunctive.
grammar: one person or two: infinitive vs que + subjunctive (review)

sections.title: Pineapples, migrants and the regions: the other side of Costa Rica
body: In this lesson you read about pineapple and banana farms, Nicaraguan workers and the differences between regions in Costa Rica. The text is in Spanish; the screens and instructions are in English. The facts are dated and attributed.
The grammar is the one you know for choosing between an infinitive and *que* + subjunctive: *quieren trabajar* or *quieren que las empresas paguen*.

items: I can choose between an infinitive and *que* + subjunctive, depending on who does the second action.
I can say what workers and organisations want.
I can tell which regions have the biggest gaps.
